race.comment: RUINATION (10) justified the heavy support into favouritism on resumption with a slogging on speed win over 1100m at Canterbury in the soft (7) conditions. Well regarded by the stable and can go on with the job now. SOVEREIGN HILL (5) raced without luck first up, then stalked the speed to salute at the good odds defeating Ernaux over 1200m at Randwick. That form has since been franked and sure to be thereabouts. EAGLE EXPRESS (6) scored a long overdue win first up with the 52kg over 1200m at this track. Kept up to the mark with a trial and stays in the mix. KARINSKA (9) handy return and don't dismiss with the claim.
